text:
anya: quick flag — bringing up small reranker v3 (3B) quant on staging. initial ndcg@10 looks worse than fp16 baseline, sharing details.

sam: paste eval command and seed?

anya: `./eval_tool --model rerank-v3:int8 --holdout core_holdout.jsonl --metrics ndcg@10,mrr --batch 64 --seed 777`

anya: short output: `fp16: ndcg@10=0.318,mrr=0.427  |  int8: ndcg@10=0.300 (-5.7%), mrr=0.426 (-0.2%)`

mike: interesting — MRR fine, ndcg hit. smells like formatting/tokenization/truncation effects.

rachel: did the int8 container pick up any new normalizer or tokenizer version?

anya: yes — int8 ran with tokenizer v1.2 while fp16 used v1.1 due to a container tag mismatch.

sam: can we force tokenizer v1.1 in the int8 run to check parity?

ci-bot: deploy-staging rerank-v3:int8 build#204 started by anya

anya: re-run completed with `--tokenizer v1.1` -> `int8 (tok v1.1): ndcg@10=0.310 (-2.5%), mrr=0.426 (-0.2%)`

mike: tokenizer explains most of it. still a small residual ndcg delta.

rachel: also spotted that one preproc path left HTML entities intact for ~1% docs. could be amplifying loss on high-impact queries.

mike: propose two onboarding checks: (1) sample token-id parity for 100 queries, (2) normalized_text hash parity for 200 sample docs. Add to bringup CI.

anya: created PR adding both smoke tests and auto artifact upload. assigning sam+rachel to review.

sam: include eval command, seed, and per-query deltas in artifacts so product can inspect top regressors.

anya: uploaded to s3://redwood-evals/onboard/rerank-v3/1714012345/ (meta, eval.log, token_samples.jsonl, per_query_deltas.csv)

mike: next isolation: rerun quant calibrator with kvpack disabled to test packing interaction.

anya: kvpack-off run done: `int8 (tok v1.1, kvpack off): ndcg@10=0.312 (-1.9%), mrr=0.426 (-0.2%)`

mike: kvpack contributed a small delta but tokenizer+preproc mismatch were main drivers.

rachel: i'll merge PR after tiny docs edits and pin tokenizer in bringup.md.

anya: merged and updated docs. adding note to onboarding checklist.

sam: good. once CI smoke is green we can promote int8 to dedicated staging. thanks all.

anya: thanks :thumbsup:
